versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No other functional or structural changes in this version.

Initial release of OSRS玩家数据服务 skill.

- Provides real-time Old School RuneScape player statistics and leaderboard data.
- Supports multiple game modes and player comparison functionality.
- Requires user-provided API key; prompts user if not set.
- Offers four main tools: player stats retrieval, skill leaderboards, activity leaderboards, and player comparison.
- Ensures all tool parameters are collected, prompting user for any missing information.
